Bills vs Vikings DraftKings Showdown Picks: Monday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Monday Night Football, November 9 · NFL Week 9 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 9, 8:55 AM ET

Josh Allen has the highest SPAGS projection in the Bills at Vikings DraftKings Showdown: 20.2 points at $11,400 FLEX, 30.3 at captain for $17,100. In a game totaled at 44.5, the model's favorite play is the quarterback who also runs. It has him carrying 6.7 times, and across 100,000 simulations he holds 72% of the winning-lineup credit. The case against Allen is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 7.0 points at an $11,400 FLEX salary.

He also has the largest captain share: 22.2% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Allen at captain. James Cook III is the next captain in line, at 20.1%. The model gives him 19.9 carries and 2.4 targets.

Buffalo is a 3-point favorite, and the implied totals are 23.75 for the Bills and 20.75 for the Vikings.

Behind Allen and Cook, the next projections are Justin Jefferson (16.2, $9,800), Carson Wentz (15.4, $9,000) and T.J. Hockenson (11.1, $5,400).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 9, 8:55 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 100,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

MNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Josh Allen, BUF QB ($11,400 FLEX / $17,100 CPT)

Josh Allen holds 22.2% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $17,100 and the 20.2-point SPAGS model projection becomes 30.3 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 6.7 rushing attempts. Across 100,000 simulations Allen averaged 20.2 points with a simulated floor of 7.0 and a ceiling of 41.2. He holds 72% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 22.2% as the captain and 49.9% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: James Cook III, BUF RB ($10,400 FLEX / $15,600 CPT)

James Cook III holds 20.1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,600 and the 17.8-point SPAGS model projection becomes 26.8 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 19.9 carries and 2.4 targets. Across 100,000 simulations Cook averaged 17.8 points with a simulated floor of 6.7 and a ceiling of 35.7. He holds 61% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 20.1% as the captain and 41.1% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Justin Jefferson, MIN WR ($9,800 FLEX / $14,700 CPT)

Justin Jefferson holds 17.7% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $14,700 and the 16.2-point SPAGS model projection becomes 24.4 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 7.2 targets on 25.0 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Jefferson averaged 16.3 points with a simulated floor of 3.5 and a ceiling of 42.6. He holds 49% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 17.7% as the captain and 31.0% in a FLEX spot.

Top FLEX projections for Bills vs Vikings

Carson Wentz, MIN QB ($9,000 FLEX / $13,500 CPT)

He holds 57% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 9.1% as the captain and 48.1% in a FLEX spot.

T.J. Hockenson, MIN TE ($5,400 FLEX / $8,100 CPT)

T.J. Hockenson carries the 5th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 11.1 DraftKings points for a $5,400 FLEX salary ($8,100 at captain). The model gives him 4.7 targets on 17.4 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Hockenson averaged 11.1 points with a simulated floor of 2.7 and a ceiling of 25.8. He holds 41% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 7.0% as the captain and 33.5% in a FLEX spot.

Across 100,000 simulations Kincaid averaged 10.4 points with a simulated floor of 2.3 and a ceiling of 26.1. He holds 31% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 5.1% as the captain and 25.7% in a FLEX spot.

DJ Moore, BUF WR ($7,800 FLEX / $11,700 CPT)

DJ Moore carries the 7th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 10.3 DraftKings points for a $7,800 FLEX salary ($11,700 at captain). The model gives him 3.9 targets on 15.8 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Moore averaged 10.3 points with a simulated floor of 3.4 and a ceiling of 22.0. He holds 29% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 2.9% as the captain and 26.1% in a FLEX spot.

Build around Justin Jefferson at captain with James Cook III, Carson Wentz and T.J. Hockenson at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (157 of 100,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $10,500 for the last two FLEX spots.

Josh Allen leads the SPAGS model at 20.2 DraftKings points for $11,400 at FLEX, or 30.3 points at captain for $17,100.

Josh Allen is the most expensive player at $11,400 FLEX and $17,100 at captain. All 31 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Tyler Bass (8.4 points at $4,600), Will Reichard (7.9 points at $5,000) and Bills (6.3 points at $4,000).

What is the Bills vs Vikings spread and total?

The Bills are a 3-point favorite in a game totaled at 44.5, with implied team totals of 23.75 for the Bills and 20.75 for the Vikings.
